```plato

    //==
    // Construction

    // The rotation of `angle` about `axis`, following the right-hand rule:
    // (axis sin(angle/2), cos(angle/2)). Precondition: `axis` is a unit vector.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axis%E2%80%93angle_representation
    CreateFromAxisAngle(_: Quaternion, axis: Vector3D, angle: Angle): Quaternion {
        var h = angle * 0.5;
        var s = h.Sin;
        return (axis.X * s, axis.Y * s, axis.Z * s, h.Cos);
    }
```
